report_title: CodeMix Intelligence Step 30: MuRIL Baseline LID Training Readiness Audit

local_operations: Subword alignment testing and fixture verification
Test set isolation and zero-leakage verification

Full training loss backpropagation across 43,369 sequences
Validation checkpoint evaluation and early stopping selection

class_imbalance_analysis.recommendation: 1. Train baseline MuRIL model using standard cross-entropy without static class weights as the official reference anchor. 2. Track per-class F1 and Macro F1 on validation set. 3. If minority class recall (especially on TE or OTHER) exhibits severe lag, evaluate inverse class frequency weighting (w_c proportional to 1 / sqrt(N_c) or effective number of samples) in a controlled ablation run.

fixture_tests.description: Native Telugu word in Telugu script

recommendation.rationale: 1. max_length=128 covers 99.988% of train sequences (only 5 out of 43,369 exceed 128) and 99.896% of validation sequences (5 out of 4,820 exceed 128). 2. Compared to max_length=512, length 128 provides a 16x reduction in quadratic self-attention memory (128^2=16,384 vs 512^2=262,144) and 4x faster throughput. 3. If 100% zero-truncation is required, max_length=256 covers 100.0% of both train and validation without a single truncated token. 4. Truncation policy: For sequences exceeding max_length, truncation MUST be performed at complete original word boundaries, logging discarded words.
recommendation.truncation_boundary_rule: Truncate strictly at complete original whitespace word boundaries; never partially tokenize a word.

model_architecture.ignored_handling: All non-supervised positions ([CLS], [SEP], subword continuation tokens starting with ##, Named Entities, fused MIXED tokens, AMBIGUOUS tokens, and null annotations) receive label -100. PyTorch's CrossEntropyLoss automatically masks out all -100 positions, ensuring gradients flow strictly from the first subword of valid supervised tokens.

training_strategy.compute_target: Google Colab GPU (NVIDIA T4 16GB, V100 16GB, or A100 40GB)

evaluation_plan.primary_metric_rationale: Macro F1 gives equal weight to all 4 classes regardless of frequency. Because the training distribution is imbalanced (~48.6% Hindi vs ~9.8% Other and ~14.2% Telugu), overall token accuracy is heavily dominated by Hindi and English performance and masks catastrophic failure on minority classes. Macro F1 guarantees rigorous multi-language capability.
evaluation_metrics: Macro Precision, Macro Recall, Macro F1
Per-Class Precision, Recall, F1 for EN (0), HI (1), TE (2), OTHER (3)
Per-Subset Breakdown on COMI-LINGUA, Blog, and Twitter
evaluation_plan.test_set_lock_in_guarantee: The test set (data/processed/language_identification/test.jsonl and dedicated test files) remains completely locked and isolated during training and hyperparameter selection. It will be evaluated exactly once on the final selected checkpoint.
